content: In 2012, the World Health Organization (WHO) published a guide on local production of hand rub formulations that it recommends. This guide provides detailed instructions and tools to facilitate the production of effective alcohol-based hand rubs, which are essential for infection prevention and control. Additionally, research conducted by Bauer-Savage J., Pittet D., Kim E., and colleagues explored the local production of these WHO-recommended alcohol-based hand rubs. Their study examined the feasibility, benefits, challenges, and associated costs of producing these formulations locally, providing valuable insights into their implementation and sustainability.
